title: MCTS with an NN substrate (AlphaZero style)
author: what_eve
selftext:
the actual app code is here: [https://github.com/wlejon/broworkshop/tree/main/games/stompworld](https://github.com/wlejon/broworkshop/tree/main/games/stompworld) 

  
the library for MCTS and NN from here: [https://github.com/wlejon/brogameagent](https://github.com/wlejon/brogameagent) 

  
since this video, i have added cuda kernels and metal (mac) for the neural networks. it currently only improves the pretraining (from a few minutes to a few seconds) but will better support larger models (Transformers) for more complicated game ai agents.

vibe coded with claude code. i'm working on adding MuZero next most likely.
